reasoning: Multiple authoritative sources consistently state that there is currently no vaccine for Rocky Mountain spotted fever (RMSF). The Wikipedia article explicitly states: 'Today there is no commercially available vaccine for RMSF because, unlike in the 1920s when Spencer and colleagues developed one, antibiotics are now available to treat the disease.' The CDC, Michigan Department of Health, and DC Department of Health all confirm 'There is no vaccine to prevent RMSF.' While research into potential vaccines (subunit, polypeptide vaccines) is ongoing, no licensed vaccine currently exists. The question asks about Wikipedia's status by November 2, 2025—less than one year away. Given the lengthy development timelines for vaccines and the current lack of any approved vaccine, it is highly unlikely that a vaccine will be developed and documented on Wikipedia by that date.
